design.method: Adaptive likelihood-tempered SMC; systematic resampling; exact tempered Gibbs rejuvenation
design.cohorts: Same frozen7/69/475-peer cohorts as rejected Gibbs pilot
design.target: Original product finite prior times unchanged t5 likelihood; separate joint/departure-only views
design.means: Exact conditional target mean at beta1, averaged over final sweeps
design.precision_gate: Independent replicate SE<=max(1second,1% posterior target SD); cross-budget difference<=3 combined SE; all cohorts and views
design.limitation: Particle ESS is not independent posterior ESS; ancestry and between-replicate error retained. Passing only permits broader numerical assessment, never CV directly.
design.failure: Close this fixed screen; no particle/temperature tuning or easier cohort gate
